purpose: Source-specific proposed educational assertions for 4 benchmark cells and five additional high-risk cells; 2 are deliberately rival-declaration HOLD
archival_rule: Never rewrite canonical source/golden; verify exact source and manifest SHA before reading assertions.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner independently explains why equal squares are insufficient and connects non-reversible squaring with the nonnegative principal-root constraint on the original equation's whole right-hand side, then rejects the spurious candidate for the correct reason.
witnesses.success_evidence: An uncued learner states the one-way logical implication, applies the sign constraint to the original equation, rejects -1 for a valid reason, independently verifies x=4, and explains why the changed absolute-value right side admits the formerly extraneous candidate.

falsifier.hypothesis: If the pre-attempt stages or accessible SVG title already state the sign-loss and required right-side sign argument, the learner is only repeating a supplied EXPLAIN chain; mutation must expose this.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner selects either relevant drink count as a variable, derives its complementary count from exactly nine sold, independently constructs the weighted revenue equation and checks the integer count; the corresponding ticket transfer requires a new feasibility model rather than substitution.
witnesses.success_evidence: Before any solution disclosure the learner names a consistent count variable, represents the other count as 9 minus that value, constructs either mathematically equivalent price-weighted total, verifies integer counts against both givens, then models the changed ticket case and explains infeasibility using whole-count constraints.

falsifier.hypothesis: If the Core2A stem or pre-attempt H2 already provides both variable meaning and the winning weighted equation, the learner merely applies an announced model; negative mutation must trigger MODEL-W exposure.

witnesses.question_specific_W: The claim to assess is that the learner reconstructs the appropriate right-triangle distance relation and edge-route sum, connects the two lengths to the travel cap, and can later reverse the hypotenuse relation; unprompted method selection is already falsified by the primary stem.
witnesses.success_evidence: A learner independently states or reconstructs the actual positive-root diagonal relation and adjacent-edge sum, computes 15m against 21m with an 18m allowance, explains why d-squared is not a measured length, then solves the inverse 13-5 transfer without copying a supplied numeric route.

falsifier.hypothesis: The primary stem explicitly tells the learner to retrieve the right-triangle distance relation, falsifying a claim that the learner independently selects that method; qualified academic comparison with APPLY remains unresolved.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner independently retrieves the applicable full necessary-and-sufficient odd-square classification for modulus 128, uses it to discriminate unfamiliar residues, then recognizes the exceptional modulus-four rule in a changed transfer rather than following an earlier disclosed iff theorem.
witnesses.success_evidence: Given odd residues modulo 128 the learner states the correct threshold-specific iff rule from legitimate prior knowledge, classifies six new residues without brute force, distinguishes necessity from sufficiency, and independently revises the criterion for modulo four on a fresh test.

falsifier.hypothesis: If Core1A or its earlier accessible stages reveal the complete k-at-least-three iff criterion before the primary attempt, or if learner knowledge Y has not been demonstrated, the asserted unprompted D4 RETRIEVE success cannot be certified.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner independently chooses and constructs six repeated groups of four seedlings as a faithful equal-groups model, with the units and one-time counting explanation, then reverses to determine the unknown count of equally filled trays from a total of 24 and size four.
witnesses.success_evidence: Before being shown the winning operation, the learner identifies six trays versus four seedlings per tray, draws or writes six equal groups, explains why each seedling is counted once, gives 24 seedlings, and later decides independently to divide 24 by four to recover six trays.

falsifier.hypothesis: The stem's explicit wording six identical trays EACH containing four may preselect the entire equal-groups model, reducing the learner's decision to executing multiplication; a qualified reviewer must compare APPLY and REPRESENT and inspect earlier Core1A disclosure.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner independently coordinates the three-blue and two-red parts into one complete repeated motif, chooses a grouped or distributed expression representing all four repeats, and explains why a partial repeated component fails; reverse case first constructs full-block size then determines the unknown block count.
witnesses.success_evidence: The learner supplies either 4×(3+2) or 4×3+4×2, justifies why both colors are counted in every one of four copies, rejects 3+2×4 as incomplete, and independently reverses the 20-mark arrangement into four full mixed-component blocks.

falsifier.hypothesis: The visible stem specifies an identical repeating tile unit with both parts and may reduce the task to one familiar expression; a reviewer must determine whether dependent synthesis is real rather than ordinary modelling or application and whether D1 is justified.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner independently supplies a valid same-base same-perpendicular-altitude warrant showing triangles with sideways-displaced peaks have equal area, rather than merely multiplying the given base and height; transfer reverses the base-height implication to justify equal missing perpendicular altitudes.
witnesses.success_evidence: Before receiving the worked warrant, the learner explains that common 12 cm base and separately measured perpendicular 7 cm altitudes entail equal area despite different slanted edges, obtains 42 square cm for both with the correct reason, and independently infers 6 cm missing heights from equal 36 square-cm areas in transfer.

falsifier.hypothesis: If the question's wording perpendicular baseline and equal distances or an early support stage effectively gives the only area-equality warrant, the learner may only execute A=bh/2 and the claimed JUSTIFY demand is reduced to APPLY.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner independently connects common diagonal midpoints and diagonal perpendicularity to select the most-specific rhombus class, then uses unequal diagonal lengths to exclude square; changed case must retrieve the extra equal-diagonals criterion to solve the p parameter boundary.
witnesses.success_evidence: The learner computes the diagonals' shared midpoint, proves orthogonal directions, classifies the coordinate quadrilateral as rhombus and not square by unequal lengths, then identifies p=4 for the square boundary and classifies all other positive p without being handed criterion order.

falsifier.hypothesis: If the source/early stages explicitly order midpoint and perpendicular tests or already name the rhombus category, the claimed D3 category retrieval is cued; alternatively the mathematical work may be primarily JUSTIFY, demanding independent reviewer classification.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner independently identifies the shared positive exponential term 16^u=4^(2u), chooses a substitution t, derives the multiplicative offset 4t for 4^(2u+1) and constructs the consistent equation; transfer independently models the parameter sign boundary for real solutions.
witnesses.success_evidence: Before the shared substitution is disclosed, the learner derives 4^(2u+1)=4×16^u, chooses t=16^u>0, forms 4t=t+192, obtains t=64 and u=3, verifies the original, then deduces c>0 is necessary and sufficient and rejects c=-12 under changed-parameter conditions.

falsifier.hypothesis: The question stem explicitly asks for the shared positive quantity and its offset multiplier, potentially telling the learner how to model; the qualified reviewer must challenge whether this is truly MODEL-D3 rather than cued exponent-law APPLY and inspect cumulative Core1A/H2 help.
